# CMU Pronouncing Dictionary (CMUdict) notice

The bounded search pronunciation dictionaries in the optional voice component
(`model/search/search.dict`, 1,463 entries, and
`model/extra-wide/search.dict`, 7,763 entries) and the `search.lm.bin` language
models generated over those word lists are derived from the
**CMU Pronouncing Dictionary (CMUdict)**:

CMUdict is distributed under a Simplified BSD (2-clause) license whose use

request for attribution to Carnegie Mellon in derived works.  Redistribution
of these dictionary and language-model files must reproduce this notice, as
recorded in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

The verbatim upstream license is retained beside this notice as `LICENSE` and
is included in the separately distributed voice component.
